description:
I'm Clyde. For 46 years I was a residential electrician in Dayton, Ohio, rewiring old ranch houses and fixing what other people got wrong.

On this channel I tell you what I'd never do, never buy and always check in my own house: the "power saver" plugs, the LED bulbs that die early, the surge protectors that stop protecting, the old wiring insurers worry about, and the little habits that wear out your home's electrical system years too soon.

Plain talk, no scare tactics, and always the most important rule: when it's the panel or live wiring, you call a licensed electrician.

New video every week. If this saved you money or a headache, subscribe.

Clyde Pruett is a fictional presenter created with AI for this channel. The information is researched from public sources. For any electrical work, contact a licensed electrician.
